headline: Strongpoints Shift in Mooring County, Stlican Shelf, Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County's ledger has changed: Warden posts now number ten, Colonial two, and the day's 35 strategic-base events make it one of the busiest regions, with Gravekeeper's Holdfast the most frequent marker. Stlican Shelf has also shifted; the lone neutral post from the prior report is gone from the count, leaving six Colonial posts against three Warden. Weathered Expanse now stands at three Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral, with its heavy casualty totals still climbing. Palantine Berm has flared in recent hours, logging three events at Leiri Hermanni and sharply accelerating casualty returns on both sides. Farranac Coast remains all-Colonial with no strategic-base events in the last two hours; Stonecradle is unchanged at one Warden post to eight Colonial; and Callahans Passage remains all Warden despite very heavy casualty lists. No winner has yet been declared.
